videoTextCorrectionPrompt:
Use case: text-localization
Asset type: final Chinese desktop UI mockup, single-video import screen.
Input image 1: edit target.
Change ONLY two wording mistakes in the attached screenshot. Keep every other pixel/layout, photo, button, selected tab, color, icon, typography, selection state, product title and dimensions as close as possible to the original.
1. Under main title "导入到 AstroToo", replace the subtitle "将本地照片上传到已连接的设备： AstroToo · 480 × 480" with "将本地视频上传到已连接的设备： AstroToo · 480 × 480".
2. In left sidebar selected navigation item, replace "导入照片" with "导入文件".
Do not redesign anything, do not alter the video preview, do not add text. Keep "视频 · 每次 1 个", "每次只能选择 1 个视频", the 30-minute limit and the mandatory video preview explanation unchanged. No watermark.
interactionNotes: 照片与视频分开导入：照片允许多选，视频每次只选一个，重新选择视频替换当前项。
照片默认仅未上传，可切换全部。已上传状态按当前设备 DeviceId 隔离；只过滤有可靠上传记录且设备中仍存在的照片，不能只靠同名文件判断。
照片支持逐张裁剪或沿用第一张；后者按相对裁剪中心、缩放与旋转适配不同源图尺寸，保持设备屏幕比例。
批量应用后预览每张结果，允许单张微调，确认后再加入上传队列。
AstroToo 示例输出为 480×480 WebP；其他设备尺寸仍来自 Device/GetHardwareVersion。
视频最长 30 分钟，预览图自动生成并与视频上传。设计图中的视频预览状态不改变此约束。
示例语言为简体中文；实现时保留现有 19 语言与随设备切换的标题规则。
importPhotos:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity Chinese Windows Tauri desktop application UI design.
Style reference: existing library/editor screenshots are visual-language references only. Preserve white panels, pale cool-gray background, navy typography, royal blue #246BFF actions, fine blue-gray borders, soft 10px corner radii, practical native desktop spacing and readable Simplified Chinese. Connected product name must be "AstroToo", NEVER TimesFrame. Header language selector "简体中文". Screen output 480 × 480. Flat front-facing complete desktop screenshot, landscape around 1600 × 1000. No perspective, decorative hardware, marketing slogans, code, protocol strings or watermarks. Use tasteful realistic travel/landscape/pet stock photos. Exact Chinese text must be crisp and legible. An actionable product UI, not a diagram or presentation.
Primary request: redesign the IMPORT PHOTO selection screen for a LAN photo-frame manager. Render ONE desktop window with slim "AstroToo" header, connected-device context "AstroToo · 480 × 480", left sidebar with device/albums. Sidebar pale blue LAN reminder: "仅支持连接同一局域网的设备" / "请将 PC 和设备连接到同一局域网".
Main workspace title "导入到 AstroToo", two-step progress "1 选择文件" active, "2 裁剪与上传" inactive. Two mutually exclusive media tabs: selected "照片 · 可多选", inactive "视频 · 每次 1 个". Never mix media types.
Source row: folder icon, "旅行照片", subtle local-folder path, "选择照片…" button. This custom import panel shows local candidates after native file selection. Prominent "上传状态" filter, selected blue "仅未上传", inactive "全部". Helper "只过滤已确认上传至当前设备的照片". Summary "找到 12 张照片，已隐藏 4 张已上传照片". Upload history applies only to the current device, never globally.
Toolbar checkbox "全选未上传", blue count "已选 8 张". Gallery exactly 8 attractive photos, 4 columns × 2 rows, selected blue borders and upper-left checks. Short filenames 01.jpg through 08.jpg and subtle "未上传" tags. No play icons or durations in photo mode. Small hint "切换“全部”可查看已上传照片".
Sticky footer: left "已选 8 张照片", outlined "取消", blue CTA "下一步：裁剪 8 张". Restrained chrome, comfortable spacing. Clearly distinguish media-type tabs from upload-status filtering. No large drop zone crowding out gallery.
